sinopsis.es: Matías y su hermano menor Jaime están solos en un mundo de adultos. Cuando Jaime es atrapado robando, Matías debe convencer a un desconocido de hacerse pasar por su padre.
sinopsis.en: Matías and his younger brother Jaime are left to their own devices in an adult world. When Jaime is caught stealing, Matías must convince a stranger to act as their father.
